reference_policy: 每次原始身份+补眼直接引用，场景参考辅助；未复用被用户否定的精细动漫脸

prompts.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. One complete 16:9 landscape illustration for a video. Input 1 is the AUTHORITATIVE character design sheet: copy its exact simple round face, short rounded chin, hair silhouette, small body proportions, garment shapes and muted pencil-watercolor drawing style. Input 2 supplies ONLY olive-green irises, dark pupils, tiny highlights and sclera inside the same round eye outlines. Do not copy its pose or background. This is the SAME mascot, NOT a new anime interpretation. About 2.6 heads tall, large round head, short limbs, tiny rounded hands and bare feet. Fluffy grey-white SHORT hair with simple broad lime-green tips; grey-black over-ear headphones with a green ring; plain forest-green hoodie with kangaroo pocket and simple sparse folds; grey shorts. Very small nose, simple small mouth, sparse eyebrows, no pointed chin, no long anime eyes, no shiny hair, no elaborate clothing pattern, no glossy rendering. Delicate slightly uneven pencil line, matte flat watercolor washes and subtle paper grain, as in reference 1. Eyes fully drawn as in reference 2. Scene: sunny small-town pedestrian junction branching into two walkable stone streets, warm peach houses, a cool blue sky, natural green plants, distant pale blue hills. Bright clean natural colors without heavy sepia wash. Boy appears around RIGHT 65% of frame, body fully visible and feet above 83% of image height. NEW ACTION state 'ready to begin': one foot naturally taking a tentative small forward step, shoulders upright, both hands holding the sides of a folded cream paper map at chest height, looking forward with a gentle expectant expression. Map has just a few faint hand-drawn route strokes, no writing. Keep LEFT 40% relatively simple but still a complete scene of road and walls for a later title, no blank panel. Ground and scenery extend naturally through entire lower edge, no empty subtitle strip. Character silhouette must match the simple gentle reference rather than the high-detail anime characters previously produced. Coherent two arms and two hands attached to sleeves, two bare feet, correct grip on paper. Only one character. No text, numbers, logos, watermarks, border, split panels or collage.

Use case: illustration-story. Edit reference image 3 into a new complete 16:9 frame, keeping its sunny branching village streets, color palette, watercolor/pencil style and EXACT simple round-faced mascot. Images 1 and 2 remain authoritative identity and eye reference. IMPORTANT composition repair only: make the entire boy, including map, approximately 18 percent SMALLER, and place him slightly farther up the path, at the same horizontal center about 66% of frame. His feet must BOTH end at 77% of picture height, leaving the bottom 23% as uninterrupted naturally painted foreground cobbled road. This is space for later subtitles over the scene, NOT an empty band. Preserve the tentative stepping pose with one foot forward, both hands on the cream map, smiling simple small mouth, round face/round eyes/short rounded chin, sparse broad white/lime hair strands, headphones and simple dark green hoodie and grey shorts. Character height about 60% of frame, with head around 16% and soles at 77%; keep head-to-body ratio about 1:2.6. Body proportions must not stretch. No redesign, anime detail, added clothes texture, angular jaw or shiny hair. Keep full-size scene continuous to all edges, no borders, no typography or logos. Preserve the open less-busy road/wall region on LEFT for a later title. Output one image.

Use case: illustration-story. A new full landscape 16:9 frame in the exact same sunny village junction as image 3, shot 2 of the sequence. Image 1 is ALWAYS the primary character identity and simple hand-drawn pencil-watercolor style; image 2 eye colors and completed round eyes only. Image 3 establishes the exact environment, camera, scale and location. Keep its same boy centered at 65% width, full body with soles around 77% height. The scene extends into foreground cobbled road to the bottom. Change the character action meaningfully: he has STOPPED mid-decision with BOTH bare feet planted apart at the fork, shoulders slightly hunched and head tilted down to read his open cream map; eyebrows slightly raised in puzzled thought, tiny slightly curved worried mouth. Both small hands hold the map closer and tilted toward his face, wrists visibly connected to simple hoodie sleeves. Map has the same faint route drawings. His gaze is at the map, not the viewer. Preserve exact short rounded chin/round cheek silhouette, simple circular eyes, sparse eyebrows, broad simple white/lime hair strands, grey-black green-ring headphones, plain deep green hoodie, grey shorts, 2.6-head-height small body. No anime detail, pointed chin, hair gloss, hyper-detailed fabric or realistic fingers. Keep all background positions and bright natural sun and blue sky, camera static; only the boy's pose and map orientation change, do not mirror or reposition the boy. Left 40% remains less busy for later type. Key feet remain well above the bottom subtitle position. No generated writing, labels, text, logos, watermark, border, panels or extra people. One complete illustrated state.

Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE landscape 16:9 narrative frame, third shot of the same village-junction story. Identity and drawing style MUST match image 1: simple round face with short rounded chin, short fluffy grey-white hair with broad green tips, small 2.6-head-tall mascot, simple green hoodie/grey shorts/bare feet, dark headphones with green rings, sparse pencil line and matte watercolor without detailed anime textures. Image 2 only supplies olive irises and dark pupils inside round eyes. Image 3 supplies village environment and character's cream folded map, not a new identity. NEW CAMERA and ACTION: medium three-quarter front view of the boy paused beside the same waist-high warm stone wall at the road junction. He has carefully spread his cream map open over the top of the low stone wall and is looking down at it with interest, his left hand holding a paper corner and right index finger touching a junction drawn on the map. This is examining a way to understand his direction after feeling stuck, not a completed solution. Keep simple broad route sketch with mountains on map, no printed words or labels. Frame the boy on RIGHT 60–70% width, his face and two working hands comfortably within 25–70% of image height. Camera is closer than shots 1 and 2, with map, face and thoughtfulness readable, body reasonably framed without unnatural cropped wrists. Background still shows the same peach house, wrought-iron fence and two diverging lanes, pale blue lake/hills beyond; new viewpoint but same geography, not indoors. Left area is less busy road and pale wall for later small HUMAN 3.0 title; no blank card. Scene extends naturally to lower edge with foreground stone/road; bottom caption band will cover 88–96% height, keep critical actions above 78%. Preserve exact cute simple round-face identity, short limbs, small rounded hands. No sharp nose/chin, no long eyelashes or long almond eyes, no shiny hair strands, no patterned hoodie. Gentle fresh blue/green/peach colors with watercolor paper texture. Only one complete character, exactly two connected arms/hands with clear map contact. No writing, letters, numbers, text boxes, glowing icons, diagrams floating in air, logos, watermark or panels.

Use case: illustration-story. ONE complete landscape 16:9 watercolor/pencil story illustration, shot 4 in the exact sunny village junction of image 3. Image 1 is authoritative character identity/proportions/simple hand-drawn style, image 2 only completed olive iris/dark pupil/round eyes, image 3 only location/costume/color continuity. Reproduce the original small round-faced 2.6-head-height mascot exactly: short rounded chin, short broad-strand white/green-tipped hair, small dot nose and simple small smile, grey-black headphones green rings, plain forest-green hoodie kangaroo pocket, grey shorts and bare feet, sparse pencil lines and matte watercolor. No pointed jaw, adolescent anime face, long almond eyes, elaborate hair highlights, muscular hands or busy clothing pattern. Scene/story: after consulting the map, he chooses the RIGHT-hand rising village lane and begins walking onto it deliberately. New slightly side-front medium-wide camera looks toward that lane; show his face in THREE-QUARTER FRONT, looking toward the chosen road with quiet confidence. Left hand holds his now folded cream map down beside his waist; right arm naturally balances the forward step. One foot is firmly on the first low broad stone step, other foot on the lower path, coherent weight and two connected legs. No jumping or dangerous cliff. The fork and lower unchosen lane remain recognizable behind on LEFT; the warm stone wall, green plants, peach building and blue sky continue same geography. The route ahead leads into sunlit village, not a completed summit. Character occupies about 58% of frame height, soles at no lower than 78% of image height, centered around 62% width, keeping all hands and feet safely above the bottom subtitle area. Lower 22% is full natural cobbled street/flowers, not a blank strip. Compose for forward direction with visible open road to the RIGHT. The substantial action change is choosing and stepping into the road with map folded, not posing at viewer. One protagonist only. No text, arrows, overlays, glowing route, numbers, logo, border, split scene or collage.
